default.summary: Boot the production kernel and init from the RAM disk.

shell.title: Shell
shell.summary: Run an interactive shell over the remote serial console.

probe.title: Probe
probe.summary: Run the production probe against real hardware and hosts.

suite.title: Suite
suite.summary: Run a manifest suite as PID 1 from the RAM disk.

console.title: Console
console.summary: A login prompt on the console, typed at the keyboard.

milestones.title: Delivery
milestones.summary: The console precedes power-on, the image arrives intact, and the bootloader reaches its handoff; kernel execution is measured separately.

x86_64.name: Bootloader handoff
x86_64.marker: Jumping to kernel entry point at

milestones.title: First light
milestones.summary: The kernel executes, selects its console, records firmware APIC state before changes, initializes memory and PCI, and reaches idle.

milestones.title: Interrupts and time
milestones.summary: Interrupts are routed through the I/O APIC from the MADT, with its source overrides, on firmware that is not QEMU's; the local APIC timer ticks at its rate against the TSC on every CPU.

x86_64.name: Timer tick agrees with TSC
x86_64.marker: [timer] tick rate agrees with the TSC

milestones.title: Every CPU online
milestones.summary: Every processor the MADT reports enabled is started by INIT-SIPI in the firmware's APIC mode, comes online, and takes its own timer ticks.

x86_64.name: Timer ticks on each CPU
x86_64.marker: [smp] timer ticks on each online CPU

milestones.title: RAM-disk root
milestones.summary: A RAM-disk root that boots independently of hardware disks.

x86_64.name: Root mounted from RAM disk
x86_64.marker: [fs] root mounted from the RAM disk

milestones.title: Console shell
milestones.summary: An interactive shell; the result must be a whole line, distinct from echoed input.

milestones.title: NIC link and first frame
milestones.summary: The clean-room BCM5720 driver attaches the port with link, resets it through the bootcode handshake, links at 1000 Mb/s full duplex, sends a frame the MAC counts, receives frames by MSI, and receives the DHCP acknowledgement completing the lease exchange.

milestones.title: DHCP, gateway and DNS
milestones.summary: A DHCP lease, resolved gateway, echo reply and answer from the lease nameserver.

x86_64: ARP reply received and gateway MAC resolved
ICMP echo reply received from gateway

milestones.title: Fetch from a real host
milestones.summary: The production probe fetches a known boot-server file over TCP and verifies its SHA-256 checksum.

milestones.title: Suite finished
milestones.summary: Any manifest suite ribbon; a networking first additionally requires the complete passing networking manifest verdict.

suite.name: Suite finished

milestones.title: SATA disk read by MSI
milestones.summary: The AHCI controller takes its completions by MSI through the local APIC instead of a wired INTx line whose routing is unknown on this firmware, IDENTIFY DEVICE gives the drive's size, and a read of the disk's first sectors completes by MSI; only the kind of partition table and whether a Breenix storage record is present are reported.

milestones.title: Disk written and read back
milestones.summary: An install boot copies its RAM-disk root onto the disk from sector 0 with multi-sector writes under an explicit, revoked write grant, writes the root record last, and reads every sector back identical; the SHA-256 it reports is the one the boot loop recorded for what it asked to be written.

milestones.title: Booted from an ext2 root on the disk
milestones.summary: A boot delivered without a RAM disk finds the root record the install wrote, grants writes for that disk alone, mounts its ext2 filesystem as root and runs userspace from it: the probe's ext2 file and directory round trips pass on the disk.

probe.name: Writes granted for the installed root
probe.marker: [block] hardware disk writes granted: the root the storage lane installed

probe.name: Root mounted from the disk
probe.marker: [fs] root mounted from the installed disk

probe.name: Ext2 file round trip on the disk
Ext2 directory round trip on the disk

milestones.title: Framebuffer console
milestones.summary: The firmware framebuffer lies in a display function's BAR, which every CPU's PAT and every kernel mapping make write-combining; one render thread draws the kernel log and the console TTY from a retained text grid, and at idle the screen read back matches the RAM shadow and the font's pixels for the text drawn.

x86_64.name: Console on the screen
x86_64.marker: [fbcon] console tty and kernel log on the screen

milestones.title: USB controller by MSI
milestones.summary: Clean-room x86 controller handoff, reset, repeated MSI completions across event-ring wraps, and root-port descriptor enumeration.

milestones.title: USB keyboard into the console
milestones.summary: Clean-room HID boot keyboard; its typed stages are measured only by attended boots, from kernel USB input provenance (M8).
milestones.waitingFor: An attended USB keyboard challenge; no successful human-typed boot has been measured yet.

milestones.title: Login at the machine's own console
milestones.summary: Attended boots require the ordered USB-only refusal, login, computation, screen check and logout challenge (M8); SOL boots exercise the same path as development input.
